back: A measure of the number of ways the particles of a system and their energy can be arranged; units J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹.
ΔS⦵ = ΣS⦵(products) − ΣS⦵(reactants); elements have non-zero entropy.
ΔG⦵ = ΔH⦵ − TΔS⦵ (ΔS in kJ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹, T in K). Feasible when ΔG ≤ 0.
T = ΔH/ΔS (from ΔG = 0), with ΔH and ΔS in matching units.
Count moles of gas: more gas in products → ΔS positive; fewer → negative.
Feasible only at low temperatures (below ΔH/ΔS).
Feasible only at high temperatures (above ΔH/ΔS), e.g. decomposition of CaCO₃.
Feasible is not fast (activation energy); ΔG⦵ applies to standard conditions; ΔH and ΔS assumed constant with T.
Straight line: gradient −ΔS, intercept ΔH, crosses ΔG = 0 at T = ΔH/ΔS.
